All four supplied main pages read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Three CdS/HgS/CdS architectures retain distinct exchange/deposition sequences and source-assigned optical contexts. Counterions, several feed doses and the core-size discrepancy remain unresolved. Matching SI not located or verified; cited upstream preparations and theory are not independently reviewed here.

05
synthesis

B1 · Exchange the outer CdS monolayer for HgS

One outer CdS monolayer is replaced. Displaced Cd2+ remains dissolved and supplies the immediately following C step; no washing, precipitation collection or new Cd charge is inserted. Quantity repeats apply the paper’s common B definition. Exchange duration is unreported.

Unresolved information

  • Cd and Hg precursor salts/counterions, hexametaphosphate counterion and dose, preparation of H2S/water stock, and pH-adjustment reagents are not reported.
  • No current-paper TEM micrograph, XRD/SAED pattern, refined phase, unit cell or atomic-coordinate file. Figure 1 is a schematic and cites earlier theory/morphology.
  • Synthesis temperature, detailed growth timing, final workup/isolation, yield and physical-batch identifiers are not supplied. Room temperature is stated for optical experiments, not assigned numerically or silently transferred to synthesis.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Step A says CdS grows to 3.5 nm; the later system descriptions and Figure 1 say 3.2 nm for all three cores.
  • Figure 4 inset uses bleach labels for representative traces; discussion assigns the low-energy long-lived component to stimulated emission.
